_comment: Stall signals (docs/CONTRACTS.md section NEW-stall-detectors): three log-only detectors
over a turn's tool calls, recorded as `counters.stall_signals` on every turn record and
TaskRecord, and as one `stall_signal` audit record per episode when [audit] is on. A
readout (LP2, LP4, HY1 trigger studies; benchmarks/analysis/stall_replay.mjs) parses
them without reading the code, so renaming a key or a signal is a contract change.
packages/gnomon-core/src/stall_signals.test.ts asserts the module's counters and fires
against this file, and that CONTRACTS.md names the section, the kind and every signal.
The input is the fields of a metadata-mode tool_call record, listed under `input`:
a trail is enough to recompute every number here.
log_only: Nothing in the loop reads these back. A turn sends the model the same requests with the detectors removed, firing at random, or throwing (stall_signals_loop.test.ts).
